title: Halting of the binary guard machine
statement: Let $b,j\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x,w,out$ be finite binary words, and suppose $j\leq |x|$ and $j+(b+1)\operatorname{val}_2(w)\leq |x|$, where $\operatorname{val}_2(w)$ is the natural number represented by $w$ (with its bits interpreted as $0$ and $1$). Starting the binary guard machine with parameter $b$ on input $x$, at input position $j$, with output $out$ and its counter tape initialized with $w$, there is a time $T\leq 5|x|+2|w|+2$ at which the machine is in its done state, its output is still $out$, and its input-head position is $j+(b+1)\operatorname{val}_2(w)+1$. At every time strictly before $T$, its state is neither done nor escape.
